--- title: "Tracking, Registry & State" description: "Explore experiment tracking with JSONL/W&B/MLflow, the model registry with promote workflows, and automated state generation." date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- iter8ml tracks every experiment, maintains a model registry for champion promotion, and generates state summaries. This notebook covers: 1. **Tracking** — JSONLTracker (default), plus W&B and MLflow adapters 2. **Registry** — Promote best runs, compare against champions 3. **State** — Automated state summaries with optional LLM commentary 4. **Lifecycle** — The full run → compare → promote → export → monitor loop ## 1. Generate Data & Run First Experiment ::: {#setup .cell cache='true' execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np import polars as pl from sklearn.datasets import make_classification X, y = make_classification( n_samples=2000, n_features=15, n_informative=8, random_state=42 ) df = pl.DataFrame({f"feat_{i}": X[:, i] for i in range(X.shape[1])}) df = df.with_columns(target=pl.Series(y)) print(f"Dataset: {df.shape}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Dataset: (2000, 16) ``` ::: ::: ::: {#run-with-tracker .cell cache='true' execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.config import ExperimentConfig from iter8ml.engine.tracker import JSONLTracker from iter8ml.session import ExperimentSession from iter8ml.workspace import Workspace ws = Workspace(root="notebooks/_tracking_ws").init() tracker = JSONLTracker(log_path=str(ws.experiments_path)) config = ExperimentConfig( name="tracking_demo", task="classification", target_col="target", data_path="", models=["lightgbm", "xgboost"], cv_folds=3, metrics=["roc_auc", "f1_macro"], shap_enabled=False, ) session = ExperimentSession(workspace=ws, tracker=tracker) results = session.run(config, df) for model, scores in results.items(): print(f" {model}: {scores}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` lightgbm: {'model_name': 'LightGBM', 'cv_scores': {'roc_auc': 0.9396383208155635, 'f1_macro': 0.8683879292092902}, 'artifact_path': 'notebooks/_tracking_ws/artifacts/lightgbm_exp_1778808639_8b7520', 'duration_seconds': 1.3, 'lift_over_baselines': {'lift_over_naive_baseline': 0.8793, 'lift_over_linear_baseline': 0.1945}, 'params': {}} xgboost: {'model_name': 'XGBoost', 'cv_scores': {'roc_auc': 0.9364968245776312, 'f1_macro': 0.8624632431747635}, 'artifact_path': 'notebooks/_tracking_ws/artifacts/xgboost_exp_1778808639_8b7520', 'duration_seconds': 0.61, 'lift_over_baselines': {'lift_over_naive_baseline': 0.873, 'lift_over_linear_baseline': 0.1906}, 'params': {}} naive_baseline: {'cv_scores': {'roc_auc': 0.5, 'f1_macro': 0.3339992236638944}, 'is_baseline': True} linear_baseline: {'cv_scores': {'roc_auc': 0.7866064255626886, 'f1_macro': 0.7141094496449072}, 'is_baseline': True} ``` ::: ::: ## 2. JSONLTracker — Default Tracking ::: {#inspect-tracker .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.utils.io import load_events events = load_events(str(ws.experiments_path)) event_types = {} for ev in events: etype = ev.get("event", "unknown") event_types[etype] = event_types.get(etype, 0) + 1 print(f"Total events: {len(events)}") print("Event breakdown:") for etype, count in sorted(event_types.items()): print(f" {etype}: {count}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Total events: 4 Event breakdown: experiment_started: 1 model_completed: 2 run_completed: 1 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#tracker-manual-usage .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} tracker.log_metrics({"custom_metric": 0.95, "iteration": 1}) tracker.log_params({"learning_rate": 0.1, "max_depth": 6}) tracker.log_artifact("workspace/model.joblib") tracker.finish() print("Logged custom metrics, params, and artifact to tracker.") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Logged custom metrics, params, and artifact to tracker. ``` ::: ::: ## 3. Tracker Adapters ### WandbTracker ::: {#wandb-tracker .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} print("# WandbTracker") print("from iter8ml.engine.tracker import WandbTracker") print("tracker = WandbTracker(project='my-project')") print("# All session.run() events are mirrored to W&B") print("") print("# Install: uv add wandb") print("# Set: export WANDB_API_KEY=your-key") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # WandbTracker from iter8ml.engine.tracker import WandbTracker tracker = WandbTracker(project='my-project') # All session.run() events are mirrored to W&B # Install: uv add wandb # Set: export WANDB_API_KEY=your-key ``` ::: ::: ### MLflowTracker ::: {#mlflow-tracker .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} print("# MLflowTracker") print("from iter8ml.engine.tracker import MLflowTracker") print("tracker = MLflowTracker(tracking_uri='http://localhost:5000', experiment_name='iter8ml')") print("# All session.run() events are logged to MLflow") print("") print("# Install: uv add mlflow") print("# Start: mlflow server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # MLflowTracker from iter8ml.engine.tracker import MLflowTracker tracker = MLflowTracker(tracking_uri='http://localhost:5000', experiment_name='iter8ml') # All session.run() events are logged to MLflow # Install: uv add mlflow # Start: mlflow server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#cell-tracker-comparison .cell fig-height='3.5' fig-width='8' execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} trackers = ["JSONLTracker", "WandbTracker", "MLflowTracker"] features = { "Metrics": [1, 1, 1], "Params": [1, 1, 1], "Artifacts": [1, 1, 1], "Events": [1, 1, 0.5], "Rotation": [1, 0, 0], "Offline": [1, 0.5, 0.5], "Dashboard": [0, 1, 1], } fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5)) x = np.arange(len(features)) width = 0.25 colors = ["#4C72B0", "#55A868", "#DD8452"] for i, (tracker, color) in enumerate(zip(trackers, colors)): vals = [features[f][i] for f in features] ax.barh(x + i * width, vals, width, label=tracker, color=color) ax.set_yticks(x + width) ax.set_yticklabels(features.keys()) ax.set_xlim(0, 1.3) ax.set_title("Tracker Feature Comparison") ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right") ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.3) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Tracker feature comparison](09_tracking_registry_files/figure-html/tracker-comparison-output-1.png){#tracker-comparison width=758 height=326} ::: ::: ## 4. Model Registry ::: {#registry .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.services.registry import RegistryService registry = RegistryService(workspace=ws) all_entries = registry.get_all() print(f"Registry entries: {len(all_entries)}") for key, entry in all_entries.items(): print(f" {key}: model={entry.get('model')}, score={entry.get('score')}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Registry entries: 1 tracking_demo:classification: model=lightgbm, score=0.9396383208155635 ``` ::: ::: ### Promote a specific run ::: {#promote-run .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.utils.io import iter_events run_ids = set() for ev in iter_events(str(ws.experiments_path)): if ev.get("event") == "experiment_started" and ev.get("run_id"): run_ids.add(ev["run_id"]) if run_ids: target_run = sorted(run_ids)[-1] result = session.promote(target_run, "tracking_demo:classification") print(f"Promotion: {result.status}") print(f" Message: {result.message}") if result.selected_model: print(f" Model: {result.selected_model}") print(f" Score: {result.selected_score:.4f} ({result.selected_metric})") else: print("No runs found.") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Promotion: rejected Message: Existing champion for tracking_demo:classification has better score. Model: LightGBM Score: 0.9396 (roc_auc) ``` ::: ::: ### update_if_better — Conditional promotion ::: {#update-if-better .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} updated = registry.update_if_better( key="tracking_demo:classification", model_name="lightgbm", run_id="manual_run_001", score=0.85, artifact_path="workspace/model.joblib", metric_name="roc_auc", ) print(f"Updated (score 0.85 beats existing?): {updated}") updated2 = registry.update_if_better( key="tracking_demo:classification", model_name="xgboost", run_id="manual_run_002", score=0.50, artifact_path="workspace/model.joblib", metric_name="roc_auc", ) print(f"Updated (score 0.50 beats existing?): {updated2}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Updated (score 0.85 beats existing?): False Updated (score 0.50 beats existing?): False ``` ::: ::: ## 5. Experiment State ::: {#state-generation .cell execution_count=11} ``` {.python .cell-code} from iter8ml.engine.state_observer import StateObserver observer = StateObserver(workspace=ws) state_md = observer.generate() lines = state_md.split("\n") print(f"State document: {len(lines)} lines, {len(state_md)} characters") print("\n--- First 40 lines ---") print("\n".join(lines[:40])) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ```` State document: 97 lines, 6687 characters --- First 40 lines --- # Current Experiment State **Task:** Classification **Dataset:** unknown **Rows / Features:** ? / ? **Latest Run ID:** exp_1778808639_8b7520 ## Leaderboard | Rank | Model | Run ID | Primary Metric | Score | Duration | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | LightGBM | exp_1778808639_8b7520 | roc_auc | 0.9396 | 1.3s | | 2 | XGBoost | exp_1778808639_8b7520 | roc_auc | 0.9365 | 0.61s | ## Resource Status Device: cpu VRAM Used: 0 GB ## Registered Champions - **tracking_demo:classification**: lightgbm (score: 0.9396383208155635) ## Data Pipeline ```mermaid // Dependency Graph digraph { graph [compound=true concentrate=true rankdir=LR ranksep=0.4 style=filled] node [fillcolor="#ffffff"] categorical_columns [label=<categorical_columns

The Iterative ML Lifecycle ::: {#cell-lifecycle-chart .cell fig-height='4' fig-width='10' execution_count=13} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4)) steps = ["Run\nExperiment", "Compare\nModels", "Promote\nChampion", "Export\nModel", "Monitor\nDrift"] colors_lc = ["#4C72B0", "#55A868", "#DD8452", "#C44E52", "#8172B3"] for i, (step, color) in enumerate(zip(steps, colors_lc)): ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((i, 0), 0.4, color=color, alpha=0.85)) ax.text(i, 0, step, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="white", fontweight="bold") if i < len(steps) - 1: ax.annotate("", xy=(i + 0.45, 0), xytext=(i + 0.55, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#AAAAAA", lw=2)) ax.set_xlim(-0.7, len(steps) - 0.3) ax.set_ylim(-1, 1) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.axis("off") ax.set_title("The iter8ml Experiment Lifecycle", fontsize=13, pad=15) plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![The iter8ml experiment lifecycle: run → compare → promote → export → monitor](09_tracking_registry_files/figure-html/lifecycle-chart-output-1.png){#lifecycle-chart width=914 height=384} ::: ::: ### Full lifecycle demo ::: {#full-lifecycle .cell cache='true' execution_count=14} ``` {.python .cell-code} lifecycle_config = ExperimentConfig( name="lifecycle", task="classification", target_col="target", data_path="", models=["lightgbm"], cv_folds=3, metrics=["roc_auc"], shap_enabled=False, ) ws2 = Workspace(root="notebooks/_lifecycle_ws").init() session2 = ExperimentSession(workspace=ws2) results2 = session2.run(lifecycle_config, df) lb2 = session2.leaderboard() print("Leaderboard:") print(lb2) if len(lb2) > 0: best_run_id = lb2.row(0, named=True)["run_id"] promo = session2.promote(best_run_id, "lifecycle:classification") print(f"\nPromoted: {promo.status} — {promo.message}") export_path = session2.export("lifecycle:classification") print(f"Exported: {export_path}") ``` ::: {.cell-output Cleanup ::: {#cleanup .cell execution_count=15} ``` {.python .cell-code} import shutil from pathlib import Path for d in ["notebooks/_tracking_ws", "notebooks/_lifecycle_ws"]: if Path(d).exists(): shutil.rmtree(d) print(f"Cleaned up {d}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Cleaned up notebooks/_tracking_ws Cleaned up notebooks/_lifecycle_ws ``` ::: ::: ## Summary | Component | Class/Module | Purpose | |-----------|-------------|---------| | **JSONLTracker** | `iter8ml.engine.tracker` | Default structured event logging with rotation | | **WandbTracker** | `iter8ml.engine.tracker` | Mirror events to Weights & Biases | | **MLflowTracker** | `iter8ml.engine.tracker` | Log to MLflow tracking server | | **RegistryService** | `iter8ml.services.registry` | Thread-safe champion model registry | | **StateObserver** | `iter8ml.engine.state_observer` | Generate markdown state summaries | | **ExperimentSession** | `iter8ml.session` | Ties all components together |
